Logo Dude luggage tag: options

All drawings are to one scale from the CAD geometry (1 mm = 3.2 px). Front shows the raised black ink; back shows the text the way you read it after flipping the tag over, inlaid flush in black. Built default: A, for the 0.4 nozzle. D is what the 0.6 nozzle needs: a 3.5 in tag with 5 to 6 mm letters.

A: 3 in, round eyelet (built, 0.4 nozzle)

3.08 x 3.35 in overall (78 x 85 mm), 4.04 mm thick, hole 6 mm. Face strokes 0.92 to 3.96 mm.
